points.description: States the time scale (length of the process / duration over which a hydrologic process occurs) as one of the two important scales.
points.partial_credit: Half if only 'scale' of time is hinted vaguely (e.g. 'duration') without clear naming.

points.description: States the spatial scale (length/area over which a hydrologic process occurs) as the other important scale.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated (e.g. 'area' or 'size') without naming it a spatial/length scale.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming both time scale and spatial scale; clear synonyms like 'temporal scale' and 'length/area scale' are accepted. Give 1 mark if only one is correct or both are stated vaguely. Give 0 for unrelated answers; a wrong scale does not cancel the other correct one. The 'availability of drinking water' phrase in the model answer is not required.
